aviation_incidents.headline: 俄軍安-12運輸機墜毀西伯利亞 機上19人全數罹難
aviation_incidents.summary: 俄羅斯安-12軍用運輸機2026年11月17日在西伯利亞克麥羅沃州墜毀，國防部表示機上19人全數罹難，較先前報導的17人上修。該機執行定期飛行任務時墜落無人居住地區；初步研判為技術故障，調查仍在進行。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Russian military An-12 crashes in Siberia, killing all 19 on board
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Russian An-12 military transport aircraft crashed in an uninhabited area of Kemerovo, Siberia, on November 17, 2026. Russia's Defence Ministry said all 19 people on board were killed, revising an earlier reported toll of 17. The ministry said the aircraft was on a scheduled flight; preliminary findings point to a technical malfunction, and an investigation is underway.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 俄軍機穿越臺灣防空識別區 國防部譴責衝擊區域穩定
taiwan_aviation.summary: 俄軍機11月17日清晨航經臺灣東部並穿越臺灣防空識別區，國防部表示已監控並適切應處，譴責穿越識別區及被指侵犯鄰國領空的行為，認為衝擊區域穩定；未透露兵力部署細節。防空識別區不同於領空，此說明不代表俄機進入臺灣領空。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan defence ministry condemns Russian military aircraft for crossing its air defence identification zone
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Russian military aircraft flew through airspace east of Taiwan and crossed Taiwan's air defence identification zone early on November 17, the defence ministry said. It said the military monitored and responded to the activity, and condemned the crossing and the reported violations of a neighbouring country's airspace as harmful to regional stability. The ministry did not disclose deployment details. An air defence identification zone is distinct from territorial airspace; the statement did not establish that the aircraft entered Taiwan's airspace.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 臺灣虎航故宮彩繪機預計11月19日首航福岡
taiwan_aviation.summary: 臺灣虎航與國立故宮博物院合作的聯名彩繪機預計11月19日首航日本福岡。機身融入10件國寶級文物與畫作，包括翠玉白菜、肉形石及毛公鼎；首航旅客可獲限定聯名購物袋。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Tigerair Taiwan set to debut National Palace Museum livery on Nov. 19 Fukuoka flight
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Tigerair Taiwan's aircraft in a National Palace Museum livery is scheduled to fly to Fukuoka, Japan, on November 19, marking its first flight in the new design. The livery features 10 cultural objects and paintings, including the Jadeite Cabbage, Meat-shaped Stone and Mao Gong Ding. Passengers on the first flight can receive a limited-edition co-branded shopping bag.

international_aviation.headline: 美國議員就部分民用航空器交通資訊接收設備達原則協議 軍機要求未定
international_aviation.summary: 美國議員2026年11月17日就航空安全立法達成原則協議，擬要求已受ADS-B Out規範的民用航空器配備自動回報監視廣播接收（ADS-B In）設備，以取得周圍交通資訊；軍機設備要求未定，協議仍須國會批准。立法源於2025年1月29日美國航空5342號班機與陸軍黑鷹直升機在華盛頓雷根國家機場附近相撞，客機上64人全數罹難，直升機3名機組員也罹難。
international_aviation.headline_en: US lawmakers agree in principle on traffic-awareness equipment for some civil aircraft; military requirements unresolved
international_aviation.summary_en: US lawmakers reached an agreement in principle on November 17, 2026, to require civil aircraft already subject to ADS-B Out rules to carry Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast In (ADS-B In) receivers for nearby traffic information. Military aircraft equipment requirements remain unresolved, and the agreement still needs congressional approval. The legislation was prompted by the January 29, 2025 collision near Washington's Reagan National Airport between American Airlines Flight 5342 and an Army Black Hawk helicopter, which killed all 64 aboard the airliner and three helicopter crew members.

international_aviation.headline: 航空短訊：亞太航空協會籲政府支援航空業 2028年法恩堡航展擴增空間 羅馬尼亞接收兩架IAR-99 SM教練機
international_aviation.summary: 亞太航空協會呼籲各國政府支援航空公司：10月噴射燃油每桶約186美元，燃油占營運成本約33%；2026年前9個月亞太航空客運量成長1.9%、平均載客率創83%新高，業者獲利仍受壓。 2028年法恩堡航展的展覽與貴賓接待空間已有93%售出或預留，主辦方另增設1,900平方公尺空間。 羅馬尼亞接收首批兩架升級後的IAR-99 SM教練機，支援F-16飛行員訓練；10架教練機升級計畫的交付較原定時程延後逾兩年。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aviation briefs: Asia Pacific airlines group seeks government support; Farnborough 2028 airshow adds space; Romania receives IAR-99 SM trainers
international_aviation.summary_en: The Association of Asia Pacific Airlines urged governments to support airlines as jet fuel cost about $186 a barrel in October and accounted for roughly 33% of operating costs. Despite 1.9% regional passenger traffic growth and a record 83% average load factor in the first nine months of 2026, airline margins remained under pressure. The 2028 Farnborough Airshow has sold or reserved 93% of its exhibition and hospitality space, and the organiser is adding 1,900 square metres of space. Romania received the first two upgraded IAR-99 SM trainers to support F-16 pilot training; deliveries in the 10-aircraft upgrade programme are more than two years behind the original schedule.

international_aviation.headline: 德國 AeroForce X 偵察機完成有人駕駛首飛 無人飛行日期尚未公布
international_aviation.summary: 德國 Aerodata 的 AeroForce X 偵察機原型機11月14日在施特勞斯貝格機場完成首飛，飛行員在機上操作；公司表示操控、穩定性及關鍵系統測試達成目標。後續規劃先進行更多有人駕駛飛行與自動駕駛測試，再展開無人飛行，日期尚未公布；最長40小時續航仍是研發目標，並非首飛已驗證的性能。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aerodata's AeroForce X completes piloted maiden flight; unpiloted flight date unannounced
international_aviation.summary_en: Germany's Aerodata completed the first flight of its AeroForce X reconnaissance prototype at Strausberg Airport on November 14, with a pilot on board. The company said handling, stability and key systems tests met their objectives. It plans further piloted flights and autopilot tests before an unpiloted flight, for which no date has been announced. Up to 40 hours of endurance is a development target, not performance demonstrated on the maiden flight.
